armyRules.name: Cut Loose
armyRules.flavor: No Legion command reaches the Blackshields, and no Legion's code of honour binds them either.
benefits: Models in a Unit with this Special Rule add 1 to their Wound Tests for Melee Attacks against an enemy Unit that is also Locked in Combat with another friendly Unit.
drawbacks: A Unit composed of Models with this Special Rule gains no benefit from the Officer of the Line (X) Special Rule or from Warrior Brotherhood.

armyRules.name: Salvage Rights
armyRules.flavor: What the Blackshields kill, they strip.
benefits: Once per battle, when a Unit with this Special Rule destroys an enemy Vehicle or Character, every Model in that Unit adds 1 to its Ballistic Skill and Attacks Characteristics until the end of that Unit's next Player Turn.
drawbacks: While those bonuses last, the Unit is busy looting the wreck and cannot Fall Back.

armyRules.name: Hired Steel
armyRules.flavor: Contract machines fight better with a paymaster in sight.
benefits: A Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Ballistic Skill Characteristic while it is within 12" of a friendly Character.
drawbacks: A Model with this Special Rule subtracts 1 from its Ballistic Skill Characteristic while no friendly Character is within 12".
armyRules.condition: while within 12" of a friendly Character (-1 BS otherwise)

wargear.name: Salvaged shield-harness
wargear.summary: A scavenged gravitic harness that still works on the days it feels like it.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Salvaged shield-harness has an Invulnerable Save of 6+, unless it already has a better Invulnerable Save.

wargear.name: Banner of the Unnamed
wargear.summary: A blank shield-colour banner, repainted by every squad that carries it.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with a Banner of the Unnamed, every Model in that Unit adds 1 to its Willpower Characteristic.

wargear.name: Hide-and-iron plating
wargear.summary: Plates riveted straight onto the Brute's warped flesh, so it no longer knows where armour ends.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with Hide-and-iron plating, every Model in that Unit adds 1 to its Wounds Characteristic.

wargear.name: Warband totem-pole
wargear.summary: A trunk of salvaged ship-timber hung with every banner the warband ever served under.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Warband totem-pole gives its Unit the Rally Pole Special Rule.

wargear.name: Contract seal
wargear.summary: A wax-and-steel seal naming a mark and a price.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Contract seal gives its Unit the Sealed Contract Special Rule.

wargear.name: Dead-man's stimm-rig
wargear.summary: A back-mounted drug cocktail that does not care whether its host is alive.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Dead-man's stimm-rig gives its Unit the Stimm Surge Special Rule.

wargear.name: Scrap ablative plating
wargear.summary: Hull slabs, vault doors and anything else that stops a shell.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with Scrap ablative plating has the Ablative Scrap Special Rule.

wargear.name: Pit-cannibalised dozer blade
wargear.summary: A scoop torn off a mining crawler and welded on at an angle.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with a Pit-cannibalised dozer blade has the Dozer Plough Special Rule.

wargear.name: Ruin-brand
wargear.summary: A glowing sigil seared into the Brutes' hides to keep the warp from turning them inside out.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with the Ruin-brand gives its Unit the Brand of Ruin Special Rule.

rules.name: Nothing Left to Lose
rules.summary: A man with no banner has nothing left to protect except the man beside him.
rules.text: A Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule cannot gain the Routed Tactical Status, but may never voluntarily Fall Back.

rules.name: Contract Hunters
rules.summary: The bigger the head, the better the price.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule adds 2 to the result of its Charge Roll when it declares a Charge against an enemy Unit that includes a Model with the Command or High Command role.

rules.name: Ruin-Touched
rules.summary: Born of the Ruinstorm, it fears nothing and nothing is left to fear it.
rules.text: A Unit with this Special Rule is immune to the Fear (X) Special Rule of enemy Models. When a Unit with this Special Rule is able to declare a Charge, it must declare it against the closest enemy Unit that it is able to reach.

rules.name: Dead Lane Raid
rules.summary: They hit what the Imperium forgot to guard.
rules.text: A Unit with this Special Rule must start the battle in Reserves. In the Player Turn after the one in which it entered play from Reserves, every Model in that Unit adds 2 to the result of its Charge Rolls.

rules.name: Rally Pole
rules.summary: The warband's colours, planted where the fighting is worst.
rules.text: While a Unit with this Special Rule is within 3" of an Objective, every Model in that Unit adds 1 to its Cool Characteristic when making a Cool Check. Once per battle, at the end of its Move Sub-Phase, that Unit may remove one Tactical Status from itself.

rules.name: Sealed Contract
rules.summary: A mark, a price, and a promise to collect personally.
rules.text: After both Players have deployed, the Controlling Player chooses one enemy Unit. Every Model in a Unit with this Special Rule adds 1 to the result of its Hit Tests against that Unit. If the chosen Unit is destroyed by any other Unit, every Model in the Unit with this Special Rule subtracts 1 from the result of its Charge Rolls for the rest of the battle.

rules.name: Stimm Surge
rules.summary: Drugs that do not care whether their host is alive.
rules.text: Once per battle, at the start of any Player Turn, a Unit with this Special Rule gains the Feel No Pain (5+) Special Rule until the end of that Player Turn.

rules.name: Ablative Scrap
rules.summary: The first shell to find the hull finds mostly scrap.
rules.text: The first time a Model with this Special Rule suffers a Penetrating Hit in a battle, that Hit is treated as a Glancing Hit instead.

rules.name: Dozer Plough
rules.summary: Nothing on the field is allowed to stand in the way.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule ignores the movement penalty for moving through Difficult Terrain and may move through Barricades as though they were open ground.

rules.name: Brand of Ruin
rules.summary: The sigil keeps the warp from turning the host inside out.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule adds 2 to the result of any Willpower Check it is required to make because of a Psychic Power used by an enemy Model. Friendly Psychic Powers cannot target a Model with this Special Rule.

Any Legionary may swap their bolter for a Gutter-forged scattergun

The Sergeant may carry a Breaker's maul
The Praetor may carry a Breaker's maul

The unit may carry a Banner of the Unnamed
The unit may be fitted with Hide-and-iron plating
The unit may carry a Warband totem-pole
Hired-gun kit: may take up to two items

modifiers.text: Nobody to answer to: +1 WS, -1 M.
Warlord of nothing, loyal to no one: +1 A, -1 BS.

rites.name: Warband of the Long Exile
rites.flavor: Ten years without a flag teaches you who still stands beside you.
benefits: Veteran Despoiler Squads may fill Troops slots. They lose Vanguard (3) and gain Line (1).
Veteran Despoilers gain Nothing Left to Lose: they cannot gain the Routed Tactical Status.
limitations: At least one Veteran Despoiler Squad is required.
No Lord of War, Heavy Transport or Armour units.
Units with Nothing Left to Lose may never voluntarily Fall Back.

require.note: Bring at least one Veteran Despoiler Squad.

modifiers.text: Warband of the Long Exile: Nothing Left to Lose, Line (1), no Vanguard (3).

rites.name: Hired Knives
rites.flavor: A contract was signed with a forge that no longer answers to Mars.
benefits: Castellax Battle Maniples may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Castellax Battle Maniples gain Contract Hunters: Outflank, and +2 to Charge Rolls against a unit that includes a Command or High Command model.
limitations: At least one Castellax Battle Maniple is required.
At most one Command and one High Command unit.

require.note: Bring at least one Castellax Battle Maniple.

modifiers.text: Hired Knives: Contract Hunters, Outflank, Line (1).

rites.name: Children of the Ruin
rites.flavor: Nobody asked where the Brutes came from. Nobody wanted the answer.
benefits: Ruinstorm Daemon Brutes may fill Troops slots, improve Fear (1) to Fear (2) and gain Feel No Pain (6+).
Brutes gain Ruin-Touched: immunity to Fear.
limitations: At least one Ruinstorm Daemon Brute unit is required.
No Chaplains, Librarians, Esoterists, Apothecaries or Techmarines.
Units with Ruin-Touched must charge the closest enemy unit they can reach.

require.note: Bring at least one Ruinstorm Daemon Brute unit.

modifiers.text: Children of the Ruin: Ruin-Touched, Fear (2), Feel No Pain (6+).

rites.name: Raiders of the Dead Lanes
rites.flavor: They hit what the Imperium forgot to guard.
benefits: Mortalis Destroyer Squads and Destroyer Assault Squads may fill Troops slots.

Attack Bike and Outrider Squadrons gain Dead Lane Raid: in the Player Turn after they enter play from Reserves they add 2 to their Charge Rolls. Attack Bike Squadrons also gain Outflank, which Outrider Squadrons already have.
limitations: No Heavy Support or Veteran Heavy Support Squads, no Armour and no Heavy Transport units.
Squadrons with Dead Lane Raid must start the battle in Reserve.

modifiers.text: Raiders of the Dead Lanes: Dead Lane Raid.
Raiders of the Dead Lanes: Outflank.
